bio.text: Jeff Hurd represents Colorado's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He grew up in Grand Junction, graduated from the University of Notre Dame, and earned law degrees from the University of Denver and Columbia Law School.

He clerked for federal appeals court judge Timothy Tymkovich, practiced at Sullivan & Cromwell in New York City, and later built a law practice in western Colorado focused on rural electric cooperatives.
